figure.note: Across every full-frame still she keeps the sheet's curvy hourglass figure: full bust, narrow waist, wide hips and full thighs in the fitted teal dress. No slimming seen.

issues.note: Eyes heavy-lidded and half-closed, one eye nearly shut, mid-blink or sleepy look. They are open again at 3.3s.
Heavy, lowered lids with irises partly covered. This is the sleepy look the brief forbids.
Eyes narrowed and squinting, heavy-lidded. Irises are only partly visible. This is consecutive with 7.8s but the irises are not mostly hidden.
Both hands spread out palms-up in a mirrored gesture. The left arm is not resting at her side.
Both hands clasped together in front of her waist at 6.3s and 7.8s instead of the left arm resting at her side.
From 9.3s to 13.8s both hands gesture together in mirrored fashion at stomach height. The left arm never returns to rest. Fingers look slightly elongated at 9.3s but are not clearly malformed.

Clear push-in and reframing. The full-body shot with shoes visible (0.3–4.8s) becomes a knee-up crop at 6.3s, then tightens further to a mid-thigh crop at 9.3s. This breaks the static full-body brief.

summary: She reads as Priya throughout and keeps her curvy figure, and the outfit and background stay consistent. However, the camera pushes in noticeably from 6.3s, she gestures with both hands, mirrored, from 4.8s onward, and her eyes go heavy-lidded at 1.8s, 7.8s and 9.3s.
